customer_name: Saudi Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority (SDAIA)
business_problem: SDAIA needed national-scale infrastructure, governance, and practical AI services to move Saudi Arabia from strategy into operational data sharing, analytics, and Arabic-language AI adoption across government entities.
solution_summary: Accenture worked with SDAIA on a broad public-sector data and AI build-out that combines infrastructure, data sharing, analytics, and language AI. The program established national cloud infrastructure and the National Data Bank so government entities can share data securely and efficiently instead of operating in isolated silos. On top of that foundation, the team supported AI research and development for an Arabic natural-language-processing mobile app and helped create Estishraf, a national insights and analytics platform used for planning and decision support. Accenture also assisted SDAIA in launching the National Data Management Office to set foundational regulations for data and AI. The resulting architecture ties governed cross-agency data exchange to analytics and citizen-facing AI capabilities, giving SDAIA a practical operating model for public-sector AI rather than a strategy document alone. It also pairs the platform work with national talent-building efforts so more agencies can adopt the new services safely and at scale.

data_flow: Government-system data is connected into the National Data Bank through the national cloud infrastructure, where it can be shared securely across entities. Estishraf consumes that governed data for planning and insight generation, while the Arabic NLP app applies AI capabilities in an end-user service built on the same national foundation.
business_outcome: SDAIA established a practical data-and-AI operating foundation for Saudi Arabia, giving agencies secure data sharing, national analytics, and an operational Arabic AI service while enabling broader digital-economy adoption across the Kingdom.
